name: International Stable Currency
oneLiner: ISC is a purchasing-power token tracking a basket of physical gold, investment-grade bonds, T-bills, global equities, and cash; price appreciates over time.
collateral: Basket of real-world assets (gold, bonds, T-bills, equity, cash)
pegMechanism: RWA-indexed basket tracking purchasing power; price appreciates over time

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: ISC has a single Solana deployment in the reviewed metadata and no sourced bridge, lockbox, or cross-chain route was resolved. Pharos treats this secondary-triage row as single-chain/native.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: ISC's Solana mint has a non-null freeze authority, and Solana token accounts can be frozen when a mint retains freeze authority. That is direct holder-account freeze capability.

mintAuthority.summary: ISC is a standard Solana SPL token whose mint and freeze authority is immutable 2-of-3 SPL Token multisig 3XM6WqYLx5gKpRNwnCcUrBmJAhRHx3imktwEvbRwXavZ. Its three signers are on-curve externally signable public keys. The mint and multisig are governed only by the immutable Token Program; no custom upgradeable program sits in the issuance path.
